name: my-business-brain
description: My Business Brain by Abraham: a self-healing second brain for your business inside Claude. Remembers your products, prices, customers, policies and decisions with sources, answers with hybrid search and verified citations, flags conflicts and overlaps, bulk-loads documents with parallel readers, vets official information with an independent checker against trusted sources, analyses the business to consulting standard, and puts contract deadlines on your calendar (Contract Clocks).
